<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
const modal = document.getElementById('changePasswordModal');
const form = modal.querySelector('form');
const newPass = form.querySelector('[name="new_password"]');
const confirmPass = form.querySelector('[name="confirm_password"]');
const matchMsg = document.getElementById('passwordMatchMsg');
// ✅ TOGGLE SYSTEM (REUSABLE)
document.querySelectorAll(".password-toggle").forEach(toggle => {
toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
const input = this.closest(".position-relative").querySelector(".password-input");
const icon = this.querySelector("i");
if (!input) return;
if (input.type === "password") {
input.type = "text";
icon.classList.replace("ki-eye", "ki-eye-slash");
} else {
input.type = "password";
icon.classList.replace("ki-eye-slash", "ki-eye");
}
});
});
// ✅ LIVE MATCH CHECK
confirmPass.addEventListener("input", function () {
if (confirmPass.value === "") {
matchMsg.innerHTML = "";
return;
}
if (confirmPass.value === newPass.value) {
matchMsg.innerHTML = "✔ Passwords match";
matchMsg.className = "text-success fs-7 mt-2";
} else {
matchMsg.innerHTML = "❌ Passwords do not match";
matchMsg.className = "text-danger fs-7 mt-2";
}
});
// ✅ SUBMIT VALIDATION
form.addEventListener("submit", function(e) {
if (newPass.value !== confirmPass.value) {
e.preventDefault();
alert("Passwords do not match!");
}
});
});
</script><!--begin::Main-->

<script>
function loadChapterHistory(sid, type) {
const loader = document.getElementById('chapterLoader');
const table = document.getElementById('chapterData');
const wrap = document.getElementById('chapterTableWrapper');
loader.classList.remove('d-none');
wrap.classList.add('d-none');
table.innerHTML = '';
fetch(`chapter_history.php?sid=${sid}&type=${type}`)
.then(res => res.text())
.then(data => {
table.innerHTML = data;
loader.classList.add('d-none');
wrap.classList.remove('d-none');
})
.catch(() => {
table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' class='text-danger text-center'>Error loading data</td></tr>";
loader.classList.add('d-none');
wrap.classList.remove('d-none');
});
}
</script>
<script>
let currentDate = new Date();
let currentSid = 0;
function formatMonth(date) {
return date.toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
}
function openHistoryModal(sid) {
currentSid = sid;
currentDate = new Date(); // reset to current
loadHistory();
}
function changeMonth(step) {
currentDate.setMonth(currentDate.getMonth() + step);
loadHistory();
}
function loadHistory() {
const loader = document.getElementById("historyLoader");
const data = document.getElementById("historyData");
const title = document.getElementById("historyMonth");
loader.classList.remove("d-none");
data.classList.add("d-none");
title.innerText = formatMonth(currentDate);
let month = currentDate.getMonth() + 1;
let year = currentDate.getFullYear();
fetch(`class_history.php?sid=${currentSid}&month=${month}&year=${year}`)
.then(res => res.text())
.then(html => {
data.innerHTML = html;
})
.catch(() => {
data.innerHTML = "<div class='text-danger text-center'>Error loading data</div>";
})
.finally(() => {
loader.classList.add("d-none");
data.classList.remove("d-none");
});
}
</script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
let scheduleModal = document.getElementById('scheduleModal');
scheduleModal.addEventListener('show.bs.modal', function (event) {
let button = event.relatedTarget;
let teacherId = button.getAttribute('data-id');
let content = document.getElementById('scheduleContent');
// Show loader
content.innerHTML = `
<div class="text-center py-10">
<span class="spinner-border text-primary"></span>
</div>
`;
// Fetch data
fetch("get_schedule.php?tid=" + teacherId)
.then(response => response.text())
.then(data => {
content.innerHTML = data;
})
.catch(error => {
content.innerHTML = "<div class='text-danger'>Error loading schedule</div>";
console.error(error);
});
});
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
const btn = e.target.closest(".view-schedule-link");
if (!btn) return;
const sid = btn.dataset.sid;
const tid = btn.dataset.tid;
const modalContent = document.getElementById("modal-schedule-content");
// Loading UI
modalContent.innerHTML = `
<div class="text-center py-5">
<span class="spinner-border text-primary"></span>
</div>
`;
fetch("student-schedule.php", {
method: "POST",
headers: {
"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
},
body: `sid=${sid}&tid=${tid}`
})
.then(res => res.text())
.then(data => {
modalContent.innerHTML = data;
})
.catch(err => {
modalContent.innerHTML = `
<div class="text-danger text-center">
Error loading schedule
</div>
`;
console.error(err);
});
});
</script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
const ageModal = document.getElementById('ageModal');
if (!ageModal) return;
ageModal.addEventListener('show.bs.modal', function (event) {
let button = event.relatedTarget;
if (!button) return;
// ✅ Get values from button
let studentId = button.getAttribute('data-id');
let birthYear = button.getAttribute('data-birth_year');
// ✅ Set hidden input
document.getElementById('modalStudentId').value = studentId;
// ✅ Set dropdown value
let yearSelect = document.getElementById('modalBirthYear');
if (yearSelect && birthYear) {
yearSelect.value = birthYear;
}
});
});
</script>

<!-- Advance Reschedule -->
<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
// ✅ Get today's date (YYYY-MM-DD)
function getTodayDate() {
let today = new Date();
let y = today.getFullYear();
let m = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
let d = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}
// ✅ Set default today on load
$('#new_date').val(getTodayDate());
// ✅ Select2 Init
$('#advanceSimpleModal select').select2({
dropdownParent: $('#advanceSimpleModal'),
width: '100%'
});
// ================= LOAD CLASSES =================
$('#student_id').on('change', function() {
let student_id = $(this).val();
$('#class_id').html('<option value="">Loading...</option>').trigger('change');
// reset date
$('#new_date').val(getTodayDate()).attr('max', '');
if (!student_id) return;
$.ajax({
url: 'get_adv_classes.php',
type: 'POST',
data: { student_id: student_id },
success: function(response) {
$('#class_id').html(response).trigger('change');
},
error: function() {
$('#class_id').html('<option value="">Error loading classes</option>');
}
});
});
// ================= SET MAX DATE =================
$('#class_id').on('change', function() {
let selected = $(this).find(':selected');
let classDate = selected.data('date'); // YYYY-MM-DD
if (!classDate) {
$('#new_date').attr('max', '');
$('#new_date').val(getTodayDate());
return;
}
let dateObj = new Date(classDate);
// subtract 1 day
dateObj.setDate(dateObj.getDate() - 1);
let year = dateObj.getFullYear();
let month = String(dateObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
let day = String(dateObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
let newMaxDate = `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
// apply max
$('#new_date').attr('max', newMaxDate);
// ✅ choose smaller of (today OR maxDate)
let today = getTodayDate();
if (today > newMaxDate) {
$('#new_date').val(newMaxDate);
} else {
$('#new_date').val(today);
}
});
});
</script>

<script>
let studentNoteModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('studentNoteModal'));
// OPEN MODAL
document.querySelectorAll(".openStudentNoteModal").forEach(btn => {
btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
document.getElementById("note_sid").value = this.dataset.sid;
document.getElementById("note_tid").value = this.dataset.tid;
document.getElementById("note_type").value = this.dataset.type;
studentNoteModal.show();
});
});
// SAVE NOTE
document.getElementById("saveStudentNote").addEventListener("click", function () {
let sid = document.getElementById("note_sid").value;
let tid = document.getElementById("note_tid").value;
let message = document.getElementById("note_message").value.trim();
let type = document.getElementById("note_type").value;
if (!message) {
toastr.warning("Please enter note");
return;
}
let params = new URLSearchParams();
params.append("sid", sid);
params.append("tid", tid);
params.append("message", message);
params.append("type", type);
fetch("save_student_note.php", {
method: "POST",
headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
body: params.toString()
})
.then(res => res.json())
.then(data => {
if (data.status === "success") {
toastr.success("Note added");
studentNoteModal.hide();
document.getElementById("note_message").value = "";
} else {
toastr.error(data.message || "Error saving note");
}
})
.catch(() => toastr.error("Server error"));
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
// Ignore typing inside inputs
if (
document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
document.activeElement.tagName === 'TEXTAREA'
) {
return;
}
// NEXT
if (
e.key.toLowerCase() === 'n' ||
e.key === 'ArrowRight'
) {
const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextPageBtn');
if (nextBtn) {
window.location.href = nextBtn.href;
}
}
// PREVIOUS
if (
e.key.toLowerCase() === 'p' ||
e.key === 'ArrowLeft'
) {
const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevPageBtn');
if (prevBtn) {
window.location.href = prevBtn.href;
}
}
});
</script>

$('#shiftTime').data('selected');

$('#shiftDate').val();

hid,

);

/* =====================================================
LOAD AVAILABLE TIMES
===================================================== */
function loadAvailableTimes(
teacherId,
classDate,
hid,
selectedTime = ''
) {
if (!teacherId) {
$('#shiftTime').html(
'<option value="">Select Teacher First</option>'
);
return;
}
$.ajax({
url: 'get-available-times.php',
type: 'GET',
data: {
tid: teacherId,
date: classDate,
hid: hid
},
success: function (response) {
$('#shiftTime').html(response);
if (selectedTime !== '') {
$('#shiftTime')
.val(selectedTime)
.trigger('change');
}
}
});
}
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function () {
// ✅ INIT DATATABLE (SEARCH ENABLED)
var table = $('#kt_customers_table').DataTable({
paging: false,
ordering: false,
info: false,
lengthChange: false
});
// ✅ SEARCH INPUT (connect your theme input)
$('[data-kt-customer-table-filter="search"]').on('keyup', function () {
table.search(this.value).draw();
});
// ✅ SHIFT FILTER
$('.shift-btn').on('click', function () {
$('.shift-btn').removeClass('active');
$(this).addClass('active');
var selectedShift = $(this).data('shift');
// Custom filtering
$.fn.dataTable.ext.search = [];
if (selectedShift) {
$.fn.dataTable.ext.search.push(function (settings, data, dataIndex) {
var row = table.row(dataIndex).node();
var shift = $(row).data('shift');
return shift == selectedShift;
});
}
table.draw();
});
});
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function () {
const modal = $('#assignCourseModal');
// ================= INIT SELECT2 =================
function initSelect2() {
$('#lesson_select, #new_course, #new_adept_id').select2({
dropdownParent: modal,
width: '100%',
placeholder: "Select option"
});
}
// ================= DESTROY SELECT2 =================
function destroySelect2() {
$('#lesson_select, #new_course, #new_adept_id').each(function () {
if ($(this).hasClass("select2-hidden-accessible")) {
$(this).select2('destroy');
}
});
}
// ================= LOAD COURSES =================
function loadCourses(type, exclude_id) {
let target = (type === 'basic') ? '#new_course' : '#new_adept_id';
$(target).html('<option>Loading...</option>');
$.ajax({
url: 'get_courses.php',
type: 'GET',
data: { type: type, exclude_id: exclude_id },
success: function (response) {
let data = [];
try {
data = JSON.parse(response);
} catch (e) {
console.error('Invalid JSON:', response);
return;
}
let options = '<option value="">Select course...</option>';
data.forEach(function (row) {
options += `<option value="${row.dept_id}">
${row.department}
</option>`;
});
$(target).html(options);
if ($(target).hasClass("select2-hidden-accessible")) {
$(target).trigger('change');
}
}
});
}
// ================= PASS DATA =================
$(document).on('click', '[data-bs-target="#assignCourseModal"]', function () {
let btn = $(this);
$('#modal_sid').val(btn.data('sid'));
$('#modal_tid').val(btn.data('tid'));
$('#modal_dept').val(btn.data('dept-id'));
$('#modal_lesson_id').val(btn.data('lesson-id'));
$('#modal_adept_id').val(btn.data('adept-id'));
$('#modal_student').text(btn.data('student') || '');
$('#modal_teacher').text(btn.data('teacher') || '');
$('#modal_course').text(btn.data('dept') || '');
$('#modal_lesson').text(btn.data('lesson') || '');
$('#modal_adept').text(btn.data('adept') || '');
});
// ================= MODAL OPEN =================
modal.on('show.bs.modal', function () {
destroySelect2();
$('#change_type').val('');
$('#basic_section, #additional_section').hide();
$('#new_course').html('<option value="">Select course...</option>');
$('#lesson_select').html('<option value="">Select lesson...</option>');
$('#new_adept_id').html('<option value="">Select course...</option>');
let dept_id = $('#modal_dept').val();
let adept_id = $('#modal_adept_id').val();
loadCourses('basic', dept_id);
loadCourses('additional', adept_id);
});
modal.on('shown.bs.modal', function () {
initSelect2();
});
modal.on('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
destroySelect2();
});
// ================= CHANGE TYPE =================
$('#change_type').on('change', function () {
let type = $(this).val();
if (type === 'basic') {
$('#basic_section').fadeIn();
$('#additional_section').hide();
$('#new_course, #lesson_select').attr('required', true);
$('#new_adept_id').removeAttr('required');
} else if (type === 'additional') {
$('#additional_section').fadeIn();
$('#basic_section').hide();
$('#new_adept_id').attr('required', true);
$('#new_course, #lesson_select').removeAttr('required');
} else {
$('#basic_section, #additional_section').hide();
}
});
// ================= LOAD LESSONS (HIDE CURRENT) =================
$('#new_course').on('change', function () {
let dept_id = $(this).val();
let currentLessonId = $('#modal_lesson_id').val();
$('#lesson_select').html('<option>Loading...</option>');
if (dept_id !== '') {
$.ajax({
url: 'get_lessons.php',
type: 'GET',
data: { dept_id: dept_id },
success: function (response) {
let data = [];
try {
data = JSON.parse(response);
} catch (e) {
console.error('Invalid JSON:', response);
return;
}
let options = '<option value="">Select lesson...</option>';
data.forEach(function (row) {
// ❌ hide current lesson
if (row.lesson_id == currentLessonId) return;
options += `<option value="${row.lesson_id}">
${row.lesson_name}
</option>`;
});
$('#lesson_select').html(options).trigger('change');
}
});
} else {
$('#lesson_select').html('<option value="">Select lesson...</option>');
}
});
});
</script>
